available_evidence_sources.quote: Focused assessment: I read the complete native final and public activity, full PROOF.txt, DIVISIBILITY.txt, QUARTER_LOWER.txt, SHARP_LAYER.txt and STRICT_LAYER.txt with their final original-version receipt, and the receiver/check summaries. No execution or independent whole-proof audit. The exact first-root result and constructive finite-path midpoint transfer are substantive additions; the quantitative quarter bound is population-only. The sharp streaming family reaches the first-root ceiling asymptotically, while its post-acquisition replay is weaker after selection costs. Existing time-symmetric dissipation inference is explicit in Skinner–Dunkel2021 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8106300/ (including discrete-time discussion), and transient correlation bounds have strong prior theory; no historical-priority or universal superiority claim. The named PSD family is only one equally informed comparator. Source-specific synthetic stopping/power, complete-law optima and finite-record path guarantees remain distinct; no general mean-rate result or physical acquisition.
